subject: Marketplace voucher redistribution for SI co-op pilot
messages:
From: Mikael Johansson <mikael@bluehorizon.io>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: anika.patel@veridian-partners.com
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 13:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: marketplace voucher redistribution for SI co-op pilot

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency numbers. We ran into a vendor-side quota issue: Veridian has an allocation of 60k marketplace credits but wants to reassign ~18k to a joint SI co-op pilot we're running (BlueHorizon + Veridian + Redwood). Can Redwood support a one-time redistribution from Veridian's voucher bucket to our pilot sandbox?

Attachment: bluehorizon-pilot-plan.pdf (overview + usage forecast)

High-level ask:
- Move 18,000 platform-credit units to a temporary sandbox for the pilot (60-day window)
- Tracking: credits should be tagged with "VERIDIAN_COOP/BLUEHORIZON" and visible in billing/export
- Quick approval needed: pilot kickoff targeted Oct 5 (EU region)

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

— Mikael
Head of Engineering, BlueHorizon Analytics
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Request: marketplace voucher redistribution for SI co-op pilot

Sooj, Vanessa — forwarding BlueHorizon + Veridian request. They need a one-time redistribution of 18k marketplace credits to a sandbox tagged for the co-op pilot. Pilot is EU-region, 60-day window.

Initial thoughts / ask: can we do redistribution without revoking Veridian's commitment and still keep finance auditability? Ben, can you advise on billing/tagging and whether we need a contract amendment or a voucher re-issuance?

Sooj — please check security/compliance flags (third-party tagging and expiry) and confirm any gating items.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
(Attachment: marketplace-voucher-terms.docx)
From: soojin.lee@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 08:33:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: marketplace voucher redistribution for SI co-op pilot

On Wed, 23 Sep 2026 at 14:05, marissa.cole@redwood.com wrote:
> Sooj, Vanessa — forwarding BlueHorizon + Veridian request. They need a one-time redistribution of 18k marketplace credits to a sandbox tagged for the co-op pilot. Pilot is EU-region, 60-day window.
>
Thanks Marissa — quick security/ops check:
- Tagging is fine; we can create the tag "VERIDIAN_COOP/BLUEHORIZON" and ensure it surfaces in the billing export.
- Short expiry (60 days) is allowed but our platform enforces a 7-day lead time for voucher issuance to allow auditing.
- We need explicit consent from Veridian's billing admin (email verification) and a signed amendment or DocuSign link that acknowledges reallocation.

Two action items for the external side:
1) Veridian billing admin to confirm reallocation (reply-all OK)
2) Sign the reallocation amendment (I can draft a short doc)

I'll draft the amendment and loop Legal if needed. No platform-level security blockers.

— Soojin
Sr. Security & Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: logan.wright@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 11:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: marketplace voucher redistribution for SI co-op pilot

Team — finance ops note: we can do a voucher reassignment but prefer issuing a temporary voucher to BlueHorizon (sourced from Veridian's pool) and marking the source in the ledger, rather than changing the original voucher metadata in place. That keeps audit trails clean.

Requirements from us:
- Signed reallocation doc or explicit email from Veridian billing admin authorizing the transfer
- GL code: partners.promo.coop (I will provision in billing for the 60-day window)
- A one-line statement in the amendment that credits are non-refundable and will expire after 60 days

If Legal requires more, flag to me — otherwise I can coordinate with Billing to create the temporary voucher once we have confirmation.

— Ben Carter
Sales Ops & Finance I Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: Mikael Johansson <mikael@bluehorizon.io>, anika.patel@veridian-partners.com

1) Anika (Veridian) to confirm by reply-all that Veridian authorizes a one-time reallocation of 18,000 credits to BlueHorizon for the co-op pilot.
2) Veridian to sign the short reallocation amendment (I attached a draft — happy to revise).

Next steps I will own: once we have the confirmation + signature, Ben will have Billing issue a temporary voucher tagged VERIDIAN_COOP/BLUEHORIZON with expiration in 60 days. Soojin will generate the amendment and copy Legal if anything deviates from standard promo terms. Logan — FYI on partner success kickoff (you'll own implementation onboarding).

Tentative timeline: confirmation this week -> voucher issued by Sep 29 -> pilot kickoff Oct 5.

Best,
Marissa Cole
